notes.general_comments: This paper had a large number of candidates. The candidates found this to be an accessible paper overall but showing good discrimination between candidates. Many questions were answered correctly by at least half of the candidates overall. As a result. this paper showed a relatively high average mark. Overall, candidates found Question 1, 12, 14, 21, 24, 25 and 33 to have the least challenge.
